A.rule: authored personality preferred; procedural only by explicit design choice

B.rule: resolve one full procedural profile when first promoted/materialized as interactive

C.rule: full profile optional; persistent entities receive latent deterministic personality_seed when useful

warning: These A/B/C personality depth tiers are not the same thing as population/materialization tiers elsewhere in the project.
promotion_rules: C→B promotion resolves the full profile once from the persistent personality seed and any already-observed behavior constraints.
If a C NPC has already spoken or acted in a way witnessed by the player, the resolved B profile must be compatible with those recorded observations.
B→A does not reroll personality. An authored expansion may deepen the existing profile but must preserve established traits/history unless a deliberate character-development event explains changes.
A/B profiles remain permanently linked to entity_id.
A C entity that never becomes interaction-relevant may remain lightweight indefinitely.
creation_order: if tier A or B: core personality resolves

authored_mode.rule: Principal NPCs may use a hand-authored personality_profile_id and authored notes.
authored_mode.required_preservation: Once exposed in play, authored revisions must preserve established behavior unless represented character development explains the change.

forbidden: rerolling because a dialogue session restarts
replacing personality when NPC changes rank/ship/uniform
using canonical character names as procedural personality templates
